text.arabic_uthmani: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَأَجْمَعُوٓا۟ أَن يَجْعَلُوهُ فِى غَيَٰبَتِ ٱلْجُبِّ ۚ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُم بِأَمْرِهِمْ هَٰذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

baseline.text: Onu götürüp kuyunun derinliğine bırakmaya karar verdiklerinde ona, "Sen onların bu yaptıklarını, onlar farkında değilken kendilerine bildireceksin" diye vahyettik.

findings.text: Kardeşlerin Yusuf'u görünmez kılmak için birleşen kararı, aynı gizlilik içinde ona gelecekte anlatıyı geri alma yetkisi veren vahiy tarafından karşılanır.
Planın hedefi olan kişi, sonunda planı yapanlara yaptıklarının haberini verecek kişi hâline gelir; böylece anlatı üzerindeki yetki el değiştirir.

activation_trace.role: A low place in which something disappears supplies the spatial enclosure used to hide Joseph.
A cut, unlined well supplies the material container that removes him from ordinary sight.
Knowledge delivered covertly supplies a counter-channel inside the visual enclosure.
Fine apprehension supplies the epistemic capacity explicitly absent from the brothers.

changed_reading.after: Their concealment becomes the site of asymmetric knowledge: his body is hidden from eyes while future truth is deposited in him beyond their perception.
changed_reading.before: They hide Joseph in a well and he receives private consolation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The hidden depth of the well, the covert revelation to him, and their lack of perception.
baseline_models.mechanism: The brothers use a low cavity to remove Joseph from sight, but at that same point a second hidden channel delivers knowledge into the cavity. Spatial concealment and epistemic disclosure coincide, leaving the concealers outside the knowledge held by the concealed.

activation_trace.role: Opinion gathered into firm resolve supplies closure and intentional unity to the plot.
Causing something to occupy a state supplies their attempt to determine Joseph's position and status.
A report that arrives and is delivered supplies Joseph's future counter-agency.
The affair as an identifiable state of things supplies the stable object that can later be reported back to its authors.

changed_reading.after: The operation they author is already being converted into evidence that its object will later authoritatively report.
changed_reading.before: The verse promises that Joseph will one day tell them what happened.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: They resolved to place him, yet he is promised that he will report this very affair of theirs.
baseline_models.mechanism: Collective resolve turns Joseph into the object of a managed placement, but the promise converts the same affair from an operation they control into the content of his future report. Agency reverses without the placement itself being undone.

activation_trace.role: Going and passing away supplies the outward transport that begins the severance.
Cutting from the origin supplies the social-severance image latent in the chosen destination.
A cavity into which something enters supplies containment rather than annihilation.
The promised delivered report keeps the deposited person active beyond the attempted cut.

changed_reading.after: They enact a social cutting and containment, but the sentence makes the contained person, not the cutting, the continuing agent.
changed_reading.before: They take him away and put him into a pit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: They carry him away, place him in the well, and the sentence still projects him as a future speaker.
baseline_models.mechanism: Movement, a root-cutting image in the well root, and a receiving cavity compose a controlled severance from his present social location. The emphatic future report prevents that severance from functioning as narrative termination.

activation_trace.role: Covertly delivered knowledge supports present unawareness at the moment of revelation.
A future delivered report opens a later scene to which the unawareness clause may attach.
Fine recognition, when negated, can mark either current non-perception or later non-recognition.

changed_reading.after: The clause can preserve both present ignorance and a future encounter in which they hear without recognizing, so the verse folds two epistemic scenes together.
changed_reading.before: The brothers simply do not notice the revelation in the well.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: You will surely report it to them while they do not perceive.
baseline_models.mechanism: The emphatic future report followed by the circumstantial clause keeps two temporal attachments live. They may fail to perceive the revelation and its consequence now, or fail to perceive Joseph's identity or the significance of his report when the promise is fulfilled.

activation_trace.role: A visible sign supplies the public legibility into which the hidden incident is transformed.
Emergence and uncovering supply the disclosure pole opposed to the pit's concealment.
A report carried in sequence supplies the narrative process that makes the concealed affair public.
Being screened from eyes supplies the hidden event that the framing discourse is already revealing.

changed_reading.after: The sentence also performs its own promise: the hidden act is already being carried into a manifest sign and narrated trace beyond the brothers' awareness.
changed_reading.before: The revelation is private reassurance delivered inside the pit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening frame calls the discourse visible signs and a manifest book, then presents revelation as sequential recounting. Against that frame, the hidden affair in 12:15 is already undergoing the disclosure promised within it: what the actors conceal becomes a sign and narrated trace for an audience outside their awareness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifest-sign framing, sequential recounting, and a hidden affair promised as report; I infer a bridge between the story level and the present act of narration. The live alternative is that the opening frame remains general rather than locally transforming 12:15.
structural_cues: 12:1 frames what follows as signs of a manifest book.
12:3 frames the discourse as revelation and ordered recounting, while 12:15 contains revelation about a future report.

activation_trace.role: Sequentially conveying a report supplies the earlier act of telling that had to be withheld.
Cunningly managed deception supplies the threatened response to Joseph's first possible telling.
The promised delivered report turns the resulting scheme into a second, unavoidable telling.
Their affair supplies the new content generated by the attempt to suppress the earlier report.

changed_reading.after: Their attempt to prevent one narrative from being told generates a second narrative whose content is their own attempt at suppression.
changed_reading.before: Their plot will eventually be disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joseph was told not to recount his vision because recounting would activate the brothers' scheme. The focus promise reverses that relation: the scheme activated by a threatened narrative becomes the very narrative he will deliver to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier prohibited telling, the scheme it might provoke, and the later promise of telling the schemers; I infer a silence-to-testimony reversal. The live alternative is that the promise offers comfort without deliberately answering the earlier prohibition.
structural_cues: 12:5 orders Joseph not to recount the vision and gives the brothers' scheme as the reason.
12:15 promises Joseph an emphatic future report addressed to those same brothers.

activation_trace.role: Taking life supplies the lethal pole of the brothers' initial alternatives.
The explicit rejection of taking life supplies the constraint that reshapes the plan.
Casting something until it lies deposited supplies the substituted operation.
Firm resolve gathered from dispersed opinion supplies closure after the alternatives diverge.

changed_reading.after: Their unanimity is produced after disagreement, with the well materializing a compromise between lethal removal and continued life.
changed_reading.before: All the brothers unanimously decide to put Joseph in the well.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first offers killing or expulsion, then explicitly rejects killing and substitutes casting into the well. Thus the focus's collective resolve is not original unanimity but convergence around a device that can satisfy removal while stopping short of direct killing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies competing proposals, an explicit correction, and final collective resolve; I infer that the well functions as compromise technology. A live alternative is simple dominance by one speaker rather than negotiated convergence.
structural_cues: 12:9 proposes either killing Joseph or casting him into another land.
12:10 rejects killing and proposes the hidden depth of the well; 12:15 records collective enactment of that placement.

activation_trace.role: The deliberate casting supplies Joseph's deposition at the transfer point.
Taking up something found cast down supplies the receiving action anticipated beyond the brothers.
A moving group supplies the external transit network to which the well can hand him.
The low hidden place supplies concealment and temporary staging between two social fields.
The cut well supplies the material node where deposition can become pickup.

changed_reading.after: The well is also a transfer interface: concealment from one group creates exposure to another group's movement.
changed_reading.before: The well is a sealed place of abandonment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The proposal pairs casting with pickup by a traveling group. The focus's hidden cavity therefore has two functions at once: it conceals Joseph from his kin network and exposes him to an unknown circulation network, turning enclosure into a handoff interface.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deposition, anticipated pickup, and a traveling group; I infer a spatial arrow from enclosure to transfer. The live alternative is that pickup is only one brother's hope and not part of the group's shared purpose.
structural_cues: 12:10 grammatically links casting into the well to possible pickup by some travelers.
12:15 enacts the proposed placement but leaves the pickup outside its immediate frame.

activation_trace.role: A group that surrounds and supports one another supplies the brothers' self-image of collective cohesion.
The repeated surrounding group image reinforces cohesion immediately before the focus action.
Joining with others in complicity supplies the shared act that performs the band's unity.
Cutting from the origin supplies the exclusion around which that shared unity is organized.

changed_reading.after: The group's exclusion of Joseph also becomes a way of manufacturing and displaying its own internal cohesion.
changed_reading.before: The group coordinates to exclude Joseph.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers twice define themselves as a mutually surrounding, supporting band. In the focus, their gathered resolve coheres around cutting one member from the family field; exclusion becomes the act through which the band performs its own unity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a self-described cohesive band and a root-cutting branch at the band's shared destination; I infer social bonding through exclusion. The live alternative is that عصبة denotes strength only and carries no group-formation mechanism here.
structural_cues: 12:8 and 12:14 repeat the brothers' claim that they are an عصبة.
12:15 compresses their joint resolve, Joseph's changed placement, and the well into one coordinated action.

activation_trace.role: Security and settled trust supply the permission structure the brothers solicit.
Purity from deceit supplies the claimed quality that masks their actual intent.
Sending someone forth supplies the father's requested transfer of access.
Watchful guarding supplies the custody obligation they explicitly claim.
Taking advantage of another's heedlessness supplies the vulnerability named in the father's forecast.
Their going away with Joseph supplies the physical action enabled by the entrusted access.

changed_reading.after: They convert entrusted guardianship into access, so the concealment is also a breach produced through the language of protection.
changed_reading.before: The brothers physically take Joseph away and hide him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers obtain access by asking to be trusted, claiming unmixed goodwill, requesting that Joseph be sent, and promising guard. The focus's taking-away is therefore not raw seizure but a custody transfer whose protective vocabulary is inverted into the means of concealment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies solicited trust, claimed sincerity, sending, guarding, and subsequent removal; I infer that protective speech functions as the access mechanism for the act. The live alternative is ordinary persuasion rather than a deliberately inverted custody structure.
structural_cues: 12:11-12 moves from a request for trust and a claim of sincerity to sending and promised guarding.
12:13 names feared harm during heedlessness; 12:15 begins only after the brothers have successfully gone away with Joseph.

activation_trace.role: Going away supplies the father's anticipated movement with Joseph.
Going away supplies the actual transport that executes the plot.
Going away reappears as the opening motion of the brothers' replacement account.
Racing ahead supplies the distracting purpose assigned to their claimed movement.
Leaving something behind supplies the fabricated custody gap in which the reported harm could occur.

changed_reading.after: Going away becomes the contested narrative hinge: warning, deed, and alibi reuse one motion while reversing who was taken and who was left.
changed_reading.before: Going away is merely the first physical step of the plot.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same going-root links the father's warning, the actual taking-away, and the brothers' later account of going to race. Their real movement with Joseph is overwritten by a claimed movement away from Joseph, while leaving him behind supplies the invented gap in custody.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a threefold lexical echo and two incompatible movement scenarios; I infer that the later motion rewrites the real one as alibi. The live alternative is ordinary repetition without deliberate lexical camouflage.
structural_cues: 12:13 predicts the brothers' going away with Joseph; 12:15 narrates that movement as fact.
12:17 repeats going but gives racing and leaving Joseph as its new causal sequence.

activation_trace.role: Covertly delivered knowledge supplies the counterwitness hidden beneath the manufactured surfaces.
Fine apprehension, denied to the brothers, supplies the epistemic failure beneath their evidence-making.
Night darkness and reduced clarity supply a low-visibility setting for presenting the alibi.
Affected crying supplies the audible surface meant to certify the account.
The worn shirt supplies the portable visual exhibit on which the false account is staged.
A garment that lies by its condition supplies the material-deception mechanism of the exhibit.
Making a thing appear through its attributed features supplies the brothers' descriptive control of the event.

changed_reading.after: Their non-perception is ironic: they manufacture what others should hear and see while failing to perceive the hidden witness who will eventually describe their own affair.
changed_reading.before: The brothers fail to perceive the private revelation given to Joseph.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the hidden act, the brothers arrive in low visibility with performed crying and a shirt made to carry false blood; the context finally names what they describe. These audible and visible surfaces try to govern perception, while the covert revelation in 12:15 creates a hidden witness who will report the affair they stage but do not perceive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies low visibility, crying, a blood-marked shirt, falsehood, and description; I infer coordinated sensory evidence-making opposed by hidden testimony. The live alternative is a simple spoken lie with props rather than a systematic contest over perception.
structural_cues: 12:16 places the brothers' weeping arrival at night.
12:18 combines Joseph's shirt, false blood, Jacob's rejection, and an appeal for help against what they describe.

activation_trace.role: An identifiable affair supplies the object Joseph is promised he will report.
The self's beautification of an act supplies the internal manufacture behind the external story.
What lies in the self as thought and inward prompting supplies the workshop in which the affair is made acceptable.
The repeated identifiable affair supplies Jacob's immediate external diagnosis of the same operation.
The future delivered report supplies the later direct naming that will answer the self-fashioned account.

changed_reading.after: Their affair is a self-fashioned but already diagnosable case that persists beneath their description and awaits direct testimony from Joseph.
changed_reading.before: Their affair is a generic label for what they did.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus calls the deed this affair of theirs; Jacob then says their own selves have made an affair attractive. The repeated affair-root lets immediate diagnosis and promised future testimony converge on a stable object: an internally fashioned operation that can be named despite its false description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated affair language, inward beautification, immediate diagnosis, and future report; I infer that both verses point to one stabilized case beneath the alibi. The live alternative is ordinary lexical repetition without a forensic naming function.
structural_cues: 12:15 uses a deictic expression for their affair and promises that Joseph will report it.
12:18 rejects the brothers' account by diagnosing an affair their selves have made attractive.

remaining_uncertainties: The unawareness clause may attach primarily to the revelation scene, the future reporting scene, or deliberately remain available to both.
The well may represent a negotiated compromise, or merely the successful proposal of one brother.
Pickup by travelers may be part of shared intent, one speaker's preserving hope, or only an anticipated possibility.
The root-cutting, buried-root, and lying-garment readings are productive branch analogies but remain deliberately exploratory.
strongest_changes: The pit is simultaneously a device of visual concealment and the site where hidden counterknowledge is installed.
Context recasts the well as both a compromise after competing proposals and a transfer interface to a traveling network.
The repeated going-root turns physical movement into a contested sequence of warning, deed, and alibi.
The aftermath stages visible and audible evidence against a covert witness, making perception itself the field of conflict.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses bodily placement, social severance, covert disclosure, future testimony, and failed perception into one hinge. Context activates several coexisting readings without resolving the temporal ambiguity of وهم لا يشعرون: the concealed victim becomes knower, the group's compromise becomes a route, suppressed telling generates testimony, and fabricated surfaces are opposed by hidden speech.

activation_trace.role: Tree roots hidden underground and later exposed supply an emergence analogy for latent testimony.
Cutting from the origin supplies the attempted severance against which buried continuance persists.
The future delivered report supplies the eventual surfacing of what the pit holds latent.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pit resembles earth holding a hidden root: attempted severance becomes a latent form of later emergence and testimony.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The buried-tree-root image is cross-domain and should be rendered only as a material analogy, not as the lexical sense of غيابة here. It remains anchored in the focus root and is worth carrying because hidden roots that later appear sharply model the verse's move from underground concealment to promised future report.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Joseph is placed in the غيابة, yet is promised that he will later report the act.

activation_trace.role: The shirt as a worn object supplies the material carrier of the brothers' account.
A garment that lies through its condition supplies deception enacted by an arranged object.
Joseph's future delivered report supplies the personal counter-speech to the garment's staged account.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the shirt itself performs their lie by its arranged condition, while the person displaced from view remains the future speaking counter-evidence.
changed_reading.before: The brothers lie verbally and use the shirt as supporting evidence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Treating the garment as performing deception is a branch-driven material reading, not a claim that the syntax literally makes the shirt a speaking liar. It remains validly anchored in the shirt and falsehood roots and preserves the sharp contrast between a material exhibit that lies by appearance and the hidden person promised future speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hidden Joseph is promised speech about the affair that the later shirt is made to misdescribe.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **One concentrated resolve is answered by hidden counter-information.** ج م ع B003 (concerted resolve), غ ي ب B001/B002 (hiddenness/low hiding place), and و ح ي B001 (hidden imparting) create a reversal: the brothers gather intention to hide Yusuf, while hidden communication preserves his future knowledge. I infer that concealment becomes the medium of a counter-plan. The pit reads as an epistemic chamber, not only a place of disposal.
2. **Subtle awareness is asymmetrically distributed.** ش ع ر B005 (subtle knowing) is negated of the brothers, while ن ب ء B002 (news brought and reported) is promised to Yusuf. I infer that their ignorance includes failure to perceive their future position as recipients of his report. The act already contains its later disclosure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:89-90 fulfilled the concealed promise: Yusuf reported their act back to them when they did not yet recognize him, then recognition broke open.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Report as reversal of narrative control.** `ن ب ء:B002` is consequential “news brought and reported,” while `ن ب ء:B001` retains movement or arrival from one place to another. The brothers make Joseph disappear, then arrive with their own report (12:16-18); the caravan’s arrival and his sale follow (12:19-20). Those movements and reports are supplied; I infer that survival will let the concealed object of their account become its informed narrator. *Latunabbiʾannahum* reads as a promised transfer of report-authority from plotters to the one plotted against.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:102 reports the very concealed gathering in which this future notification was announced, completing the reversal: those who controlled the secret become objects of a report beyond their control.
